data.disagreement_analysis: The first model (qwen) encountered HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to audit .SRCINFO, REUSE.toml, and one LICENSE file, forcing an 'inconclusive' result. The second model (deepseek) successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe. There is no actual security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO, REUSE.toml, and one LICENSE file due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) to prevent incomplete audits.

The tool could weigh file criticality; if only non-executable metadata files (like LICENSE or REUSE.toml) fail to audit, the tool might still be able to return a verdict based on the successful audit of critical files like PKGBUILD.
